# AI Acknowledgement
This assignment was completed as a group project. Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI), specifically ChatGPT (OpenAI), was used as a supplementary learning and support tool to assist with understanding technical concepts, troubleshooting, and project workflow management. AI-generated outputs were reviewed, evaluated, and adapted by the group members. All analysis, coding, interpretation, decision-making, and final submitted work were completed and verified by the authors.

ChatGPT was used to assist with the following:

- Explaining Git and GitHub workflows, including branching, merging, pull requests, and conflict resolution.
- Providing guidance on the use of GitHub Issues for project and task management.
- Explaining reproducible research practices and the use of `renv` for R package dependency management.
- Assisting with the setup and use of `renv`, including environment initialization and package version management.
- Explaining best practices for package loading and project structure in Quarto (`.qmd`) projects.
- Troubleshooting Quarto presentation rendering issues and providing recommendations on RevealJS themes.
- Clarifying the purpose of `.gitignore` and version control best practices.

A record of prompts used during the working of this assignment is available at:
